Residents Encouraged to Enroll in Get Covered New Jersey Ahead of January 31 Deadline for Health Coverage
recent_candidates.gist:
What happened: New Jersey DOBI reminded residents that January 31, 2026, is the final Open Enrollment deadline for Get Covered New Jersey health plans.

Who/what is involved: The state marketplace, Acting Commissioner Susan Ochs, insurers, Navigators, brokers, and residents seeking coverage.

Stakes: Financial assistance remains available, but reduced federal support has contributed to higher costs and greater selection of bronze plans with higher out-of-pocket expenses.

Notable detail: As of January 2, 493,727 residents had signed up for 2026 coverage, including 203,836 who actively selected a plan.

recent_candidates.headline: NJ Department of Banking and Insurance Provides Get Covered New Jersey Open Enrollment Update
recent_candidates.gist:
What happened: More than 509,000 New Jersey residents enrolled in 2026 health coverage through Get Covered New Jersey, while the state warned enrollment may decline as federal subsidy changes increase costs.

Who/what is involved: New Jersey DOBI, Get Covered New Jersey, marketplace consumers, federal premium tax credits, and participating insurers.

Stakes: Higher premiums and out-of-pocket costs have contributed to tens of thousands of disenrollments for nonpayment and increased risk of losing coverage.

Notable detail: Active Silver-plan selections fell from 83% in 2025 to 68% in 2026, while Bronze selections rose from 16% to 31%.
